title: Block Out Level 17 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 17 is a framed-hinge numeric board. Trim the yellow roof first, unlock the green center frame second, and only then flatten the broad cyan slabs marked `19`, `18`, and `16`.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 17 is a framed-hinge numeric board. Trim the yellow roof first, unlock the green center frame second, and only then flatten the broad cyan slabs marked `19`, `18`, and `16`.
landmarks: Block Out Level 17 is a framed-hinge numeric board.
Trim the yellow roof first, unlock the green center frame second, and only then flatten the broad cyan slabs marked `19`, `18`, and `16`.
The board mixes Yellow, Green, Cyan and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The yellow roof loosens the hinge.
The big cyan slabs move after the center frame, not before it.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Shave the top yellow row and the upper-right side lane so the `16` counter begins to fall.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Keep the framed green center locked until the upper counters have lost enough weight.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Rotate the red and blue side bars into the middle once the top lane has opened.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use that new space to free the framed green square and stop it from pinning the lower cyan slabs.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Flatten the `19` and `18` cyan slabs from the bottom upward.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clean up the last pink and blue side pieces after the center frame is gone.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish the lower floor counter once the broad cyan layer has fully separated.

failurePoints: Trying to move the green hinge before the yellow roof is lighter.
Treating the lower cyan carpet like the opening puzzle.
